name: Principality of Hutt River (1970–2020)
description: A blue field with a central white disc bearing the principality's emblem in dark blue and gold: a stylised bird above the scales of justice, beneath a rising sun.
history: Flag of the Principality of Hutt River, the wheat farm 500 km north of Perth whose owner Leonard Casley declared secession from Australia on 21 April 1970 in a dispute over wheat quotas, styling himself Prince Leonard. The principality — Australia's most famous micronation — was dissolved in August 2020 after Leonard's death and a crushing tax bill.
